newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN BANKING STATISTICS - UPDATED NOV 1.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN BANKING STATISTICS - UPDATED NOV 1.

text.p: (Updates by new central interest rate of 180 pct, changes in central bank refinancing, internal credit, broad money growth in the week to Oct 18)
